title: Marina Bay Suites
subtitle: Unit #28-05
description:
An extraordinary opportunity to own a premium 3-bedroom suite at the iconic Marina Bay Suites — one of Singapore's most prestigious addresses.

This high-floor unit on the 28th level offers jaw-dropping views of Marina Bay, the city skyline, and the verdant Gardens by the Bay. The 1,808 sqft layout is finished to the highest standard with full-height windows, premium timber flooring throughout, and a gourmet kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line Gaggenau appliances.

Direct access to Marina Bay Sands via a dedicated sky bridge, steps from the CBD, and in the heart of Singapore's most vibrant waterfront district.
highlights: Spectacular Marina Bay & Gardens by the Bay views
Direct sky bridge connection to Marina Bay Sands
Bayfront MRT at your doorstep (CCL & DTL)
World-class resort facilities on 5 landscaped acres
nearbyMalls: The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands – adjacent
